classified.reason: The nullable byte array uses null for the canonical wire -1 marker and empty for length zero. Interchanging them changes the keyed fingerprint under SS324.
classified.message: Return an empty collection rather than null.

classified.reason: Each CanonicalField comes from a caller-owned CanonicalRequest; serialization borrows the field and erases only its temporary copy. The caller closes each field through the request owner.
classified.message: Ensure that resources like this CanonicalField object are closed after use
